def transform(grid):

    blocks=[]; used=set()
    for br in range(H):

            for s in (3,4,5):

                ctr=grid[br+s//2][bc+s//2]
                if ctr!=b and ctr!=0 and all(grid[br+r][bc+c]==ctr for r in range(1,s-1) for c in range(1,s-1)):
                    blocks.append((br,bc,s,b,ctr))
                    for r in range(s):
                        for c in range(s): used.add((br+r,bc+c))
                    break
    marks={}; t={}
    for br,bc,s,f,ctr in blocks:
